title: POST /api/decks/:id/diagrams/check (D1542, #3780)
description: What the deck v2 adapter's `diagrams` method reads when a founder edits a diagram's nodes on the canvas: the diagram as it would be saved (null when it is not one), whether it fits its area at the deck's aspect, each fit problem (`fitProblems` and every node's own box), the numbers the founder's labels name (shown, never removed), and the steps the area holds. Free: no model runs and nothing is saved. D1511 (#3762).
